WITH T_PN AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT PORDERQ.POHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 AS Description, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0 AS Currency, PORDERQ.STU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS QTY, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON T_PN.PN = PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON PORDER.BPSNUM_0 = BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE PORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY PORDERQ.POHFCY_0 DESC, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH T_PN AS ( ) SELECT PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 AS PN, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 As Line, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 AS Qty, PORDERQ.PUU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0 AS ReceiptDate, DateDiff (day, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0, PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0) AS Duration FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = T_PN.PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PRECEIPTD PRECEIPTD ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PRECEIPTD.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PRECEIPTD.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDER.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 = PORDER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 != '' AND PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 > 0
ORDER BY PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 DESC, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDER.ZPOH_CATEG_0 AS OrderType,
PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS Qty, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, IIF ( PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 = 0, PORDERP.NETPRI_0, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 * (PORDERQ.LINATIAMT_0 / PORDERQ.LINAMT_0) ) AS NetPriceWithTax, PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 AS PurchaseAmount, PORDERQ.LINATIAMT_0 AS PurchaseAmountWithTax, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0 AS Currency, PORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, IIF ( PORDERQ.LINOCNDAT_0 = '1753-01-01', PORDERQ.EXTRCPDAT_0, PORDERQ.LINOCNDAT_0 ) AS AckDate, PORDERQ.EXTRCPDAT_0 AS ExpDate, MAX(PRECEIPTD.PTHNUM_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 ) AS LastReceiveNO, CASE WHEN PORDER.ZPOH_CATEG_0 = 'TRP' THEN PORDER.ORDDAT_0 ELSE MAX(PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 ) END AS LastReceiveDate, SUM(PRECEIPTD.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 ) AS ReceivedQty, CASE WHEN PORDER.ZPOH_CATEG_0 = 'TRP' THEN 0 ELSE PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 - SUM(PRECEIPTD.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 ) END AS RemainingQty FROM EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.PRECEIPTD AS PRECEIPTD ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PRECEIPTD.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PRECEIPTD.POPLIN_0
WHERE 1 = 1

-- The main query for OTD ad DOD SELECT DISTINCT PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, IIF ( PORDERQ.LINOCNDAT_0 = '1753-01-01', PORDERQ.EXTRCPDAT_0, PORDERQ.LINOCNDAT_0 ) AS AckDate, PORDERQ.EXTRCPDAT_0 AS ExpDate, CASE WHEN PORDER.ZPOH_CATEG_0 = 'TRP' THEN PORDER.ORDDAT_0 ELSE MAX(PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 ) END AS RepDate, CASE WHEN PORDER.ZPOH_CATEG_0 = 'TRP' THEN 0 ELSE PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 - SUM(PRECEIPTD.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY PORDERP.POHNUM_0, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 ) END AS RemainingQty,
1 AS LineCount FROM EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.PRECEIPTD AS PRECEIPTD ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PRECEIPTD.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PRECEIPTD.POPLIN_0

FORMAT (Year (T00.AckDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.AckDate), '00') AS Target, COUNT( IIF ( T00.DaysDelay > 0, NULL, IIF (T00.RemainingQty = 0, 1, NULL) ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.PurchaseSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.AckDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.AckDate), '00') ) AS OTCnt, COUNT(1) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.PurchaseSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.AckDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.AckDate), '00') ) AS AllCnt
FORMAT (Year (T00.AckDate), '0000') AS Target, COUNT( IIF ( T00.DaysDelay > 0, NULL, IIF (T00.RemainingQty = 0, 1, NULL) ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.PurchaseSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.AckDate), '0000') ) AS OTCnt, COUNT(1) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.PurchaseSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.AckDate), '0000') ) AS AllCnt
FROM T00
